# Solomon Smith

> CS senior at CSU San Bernardino. Software engineer building LLM-backed backend features that fail closed. Founding Engineer at Recursa AI / CourtRules (Jul 2026 to present). Graduating December 2026. Open to full-time AI/ML and backend engineering roles starting January 2027.

## Focus

Python, TypeScript, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Anthropic SDK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, RAG (pgvector, ChromaDB, sentence-transformers), eval harnesses, MCP, Redis, Docker, Linux.

## Selected work

- [CourtRules judge assistant](https://courtrules.app): retrieval-grounded Q&A over filed court orders; every quoted claim is verified verbatim before it renders
- [soc-triage-ai](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/soc-triage-ai): RAG-grounded SOC alert triage with MITRE ATT&CK mapping and reliability harness
- [arda](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/arda): LangGraph orchestrator on Anthropic tool_use, Redis executor, LlamaIndex RAG, MCP server; 425 tests run offline
- [phishguard](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/phishguard): LightGBM phishing URL classifier (test AUC 0.9943, 1.54% FPR on Tranco top-5000) with documented dataset-leakage fixes
- [claude-agents](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/claude-agents): Local multi-agent orchestration backend
- [DocMind](https://github.com/SolomonSmith-dev/DocMind): RAG document Q&A with prompt injection defense
